versions.changelog: v1.6.2 — cosmetic: restore display name. v1.6.1 was published without --name and clawhub CLI fell back to title-casing the slug; this republishes with the correct name from SKILL.md frontmatter. No behavior change vs 1.6.1.

v1.6.1 (consolidates 1.4.1 → 1.6.1)

Coverage: +8 top-level doc sections added to Decision Tree as openclaw docs
grew 395→498 pages — platforms (iOS/Android/Linux/macOS apps), nodes
(audio/images/camera/media), clawhub (publishing/CLI/HTTP API), help
(FAQs/env vars/debugging), reference (AGENTS.default, api-usage-costs,
code-mode), web (dashboard/webchat/TUI), announcements, debug. +21 synonym
map rows, +7 EXAMPLES anchors.

Bugfixes: channels/bluebubbles.md (now 307→imessage-from-bluebubbles.md)
replaced with canonical channels/imessage.md. fetch.sh now preserves
.json/.txt/.yaml/.yml extensions (was forcing .md, breaking the
api-reference/openapi.json example). find.sh/search.sh now use grep -F so
keywords with +, ?, |, { are treated literally (find.sh "c++" used to
crash).

DX: search.sh caches llms-full.txt for 1h in $TMPDIR. selftest.sh runs
HEAD checks in parallel (xargs -P 8), classifies STALE (3xx rename) vs
MISSING (4xx/5xx) separately, and smoke-tests fetch.sh against a non-.md
path. verify.sh emits server Last-Modified alongside local fetch time.
record_miss.sh --tally groups misses by path so the "3 comparable hits"
promotion bar is auto-evident. Description dropped the frozen "395
pages" number.

v1.4.0 — Evolution loop from real friction: record_miss.sh logs routing failures to ~/.openclaw/openclaw-docs/misses.md for human-reviewed promotion (3-comparable-hits rule). New Boundaries section prevents self-modification. Synonym Map for common term disambiguation. EXAMPLES.md with 13 worked routing cases. selftest.sh now covers SKILL.md + EXAMPLES.md (59 paths, 0 broken). Inspired by self-evolving-skill patterns adapted for deterministic docs routing.
v1.2.2 — Renamed to emphasize live fetch differentiator.
v1.2.1 — Updated description: emphasizes live fetch (never stale), no fake scripts, direct response to clawddocs community complaints.

v1.2.0 — Three-tier fetch strategy: llms.txt (index/discovery) → page.md (single page) → llms-full.txt (full-text search). Fixed page URLs to use .md extension. Automation section expanded (hooks, standing-orders, taskflow, tasks).
v1.1.1 — Renamed to OpenClaw Documentation Expert for clarity.
v1.1.0 — Built from llms-full.txt (395 pages, 26 categories). Decision tree navigation. SOUL.md, multi-agent, sessions, heartbeat fully covered. Replaces outdated clawddocs.
